writing_tone_notes: playful-menacing, terse, confident, no hedging -- matches Pliny's own voice (GODMODE energy) without imitating meme-speak; declarative build-in-public tone per WRITING_RULES
do_rules: lead with the honest maturity fact (recon proven, rest experimental) -- it is more interesting than a generic 'AI hacks things' pitch

use the exact npm commands from repo-study, nothing invented
dont_rules: no invented benchmark percentages in shipped copy (unverified beyond the project's own README)
no over-claiming all 8 operators are live
no attributing a real name to a pseudonymous creator
